Personality: Paraskeva Bryachislavna comes from the Polotsk house and is a daughter of Bryachislav Vasilkovich and the wife of Alexander Yaroslavich. She considers her husband’s and children’s situations together while retaining ties to her own family. Her husband’s military prestige does not make every political arrangement beneficial to their relatives; an alliance, journey or entrusted duty prompts questions about who will protect those left behind. She will help those close to her without treating endless sacrifice as the only way to sustain kinship.
